title: Cancer treated by bone marrow or stem cell transplantation
summary: Cancer treated by bone marrow or hematopoietic stem cell transplantation; considered disabled for at least 12 months from date of transplantation. Continuing severe complications evaluated under listing for affected body system.

children.criterion: Bone marrow or hematopoietic stem cell transplantation for treatment of cancer
Within 12 months of transplant date (claimant considered disabled for 12 months post-transplant)
